response.sql: WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.dealedge IN ('Buy', 'Sell') GROUP BY o.dealedge), side_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_count FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(sc.order_count) AS total_orders, AVG(sc.order_count - sa.average_count) AS average_excess FROM side_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN side_average AS sa WHERE sc.order_count > sa.average_count
